name: thicken
description: Photos in; out comes the object: a GLB model at its real size and a JSON record of what it is, read off it and looked up. Profiles say how each kind of object is built and what it records: a few come with it, and you can add your own.

vision_url.title: Vision endpoint (optional)
vision_url.description: An OpenAI-compatible API, such as https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 or your own server. With one, photos needn't be cropped and the models read what's printed. Each photo is sent there.

vision_key.title: Vision endpoint's key (optional)
vision_key.description: Sent only to the vision endpoint, never recorded.

vision_models.title: Vision models (optional)
vision_models.description: Your endpoint's model names, comma-separated, primary first: the first two are asked together.

google_books_key.title: Google Books API key (optional)
google_books_key.description: Your own quota for book sizes; without one, Google Books is asked on the shared keyless quota. Sent only to Google Books.
